faculty.name: C. Shawn Green
faculty.summary: Studies how learning conditions affect transfer, rate, and depth of learning in perceptual and cognitive tasks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习条件如何影响感知和认知任务中的迁移、学习速率和深度学习。

faculty.name: Yuri Saalmann
faculty.summary: Studies how neural dynamics enable cognitive control and the neural correlates of consciousness, using neuroimaging and electrophysiology in macaques and humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经动态如何实现认知控制以及意识的神经相关性，通过神经成像和电生理学方法在猕猴和人类中进行研究。

faculty.name: Karen Schloss
faculty.summary: Studies how people interpret meaning from visual features, particularly color, to make visual communication more effective.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过视觉特征，特别是颜色，来赋予意义，以提高视觉交流的有效性。

faculty.name: Gary Lupyan
faculty.summary: Studies how language shapes perception and cognition, investigating how verbal labeling affects categorization and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言如何塑造知觉和认知，探讨词汇标签如何影响分类和记忆。

faculty.name: Brad Postle
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural bases of short-term and working memory, attention, and consciousness using behavioral studies, fMRI, TMS, EEG, and multivariate analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究短时记忆、工作记忆、注意力和意识的认知和神经基础，使用行为研究、功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、经颅磁刺激（TMS）、脑电图（EEG）和多元分析方法。

faculty.name: Kristin Shutts
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop social categories and intergroup biases, exploring mechanisms and strategies to reduce biases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何发展社会类别和群体偏见，探索机制和减少偏见的策略。

faculty.name: Paula Niedenthal
faculty.summary: Studies the function and processing of facial expressions of emotion, focusing on facial mimicry and eye gaze.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究面部表情情感的功能及其处理过程，重点关注面部模仿和眼动。

faculty.name: Martha Alibali
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults use gestures to think about and learn mathematics, focusing on the role of gesture in mathematical cognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童和成人如何通过手势思考和学习数学，重点关注手势在数学认知中的作用。

faculty.name: Brooke Ammerman
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms of non-suicidal self-injury and suicidal thoughts, focusing on interpersonal stress.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非自杀性自伤和自杀念头的机制，重点关注人际压力的影响。

faculty.name: Anthony P. Auger
faculty.summary: Studies how epigenetic mechanisms in the juvenile brain mediate risk and resilience to mental health disorders, with a focus on sex differences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青春期大脑表观遗传机制如何调节精神健康障碍的风险和韧性，重点关注性别差异。

faculty.name: Allyson J. Bennett
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of early environments and experiences on psychological and physical health across the lifespan using nonhuman primates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期环境和经历对整个生命周期的心理和身体健康的影响，使用非人灵长类动物进行跨学科研究。

faculty.name: Craig Berridge
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiology of stress, ADHD-related cognitive enhancers, and prefrontal cortex function using electrophysiological and behavioral methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究压力、ADHD相關認知增強劑和前額葉皮層功能，使用電生理學和行為方法。

faculty.name: Markus Brauer
faculty.summary: Studies social power, intergroup perception, and civil courage, examining the cognitive and behavioral consequences of group dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会权力、群体知觉和公民勇气，探讨群体动态的认知和行为后果。

faculty.name: Nick Buttrick
faculty.summary: Studies the psychology of American cultural beliefs, particularly around gun ownership and success, using socioecological and multi-method approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国文化信念的心理学，特别是关于枪支所有权和成功，采用社会生态学和多方法论。

faculty.name: Sara Chadwick
faculty.summary: Studies gendered experiences of sexual coercion and orgasm, using surveys, interviews, and experiments to understand health disparities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别差异下的性胁迫和高潮体验，使用调查、访谈和实验来理解健康差异。

faculty.name: John J. Curtin
faculty.summary: Develops digital therapeutics for substance use disorders and mental illnesses, using machine learning and passive personal sensing.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发数字疗法以预防和治疗物质使用障碍和精神疾病，采用机器学习和被动个人传感技术。

faculty.name: Richard Davidson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural substrates of emotion and affective disorders, including depression and anxiety, using electrophysiology, PET, and fMRI.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪和情感障碍（如抑郁和焦虑）的神经基础，使用电生理学、正电子发射断层扫描和功能性磁共振成像。

faculty.name: Patricia G. Devine
faculty.summary: Studies how people manage prejudice in society, focusing on motivations and processes of responding without prejudice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何在社会中管理偏见，重点关注无偏见反应的动机和过程。

faculty.name: Stephen Ferrigno
faculty.summary: Studies the development of uniquely human cognitive abilities, focusing on number cognition, grammar, logical reasoning, and metacognition in children, monkeys, and native Amazonians.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类独特认知能力的发展，包括数字认知、语法、逻辑推理和元认知在儿童、猴子和亚马逊土著人中的发展。

faculty.name: Diane Carol Gooding
faculty.summary: Studies risk factors for brain disorders, including schizophrenia and Alzheimer’s disease, using psychometric, genetic, and neurocognitive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究精神分裂症和阿尔茨海默病等脑部疾病的危险因素，采用心理测量、遗传学和神经认知方法。

faculty.name: João Guassi Moreira
faculty.summary: Studies how youths develop cognitive, affective, and social skills using fMRI, naturalistic text, and computational methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年认知、情感和社会技能的发展，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、自然语言文本和计算方法。

faculty.name: Katie Howell
faculty.summary: Studies resilience and well-being in children and families exposed to trauma, focusing on protective factors and developing interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤暴露下儿童和家庭的复原力和福祉，侧重于保护因素和干预措施的发展。

faculty.name: Morgan Jerald
faculty.summary: Studies how media influence Black women’s gender beliefs and sexual well-being, focusing on the Jezebel stereotype.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究媒体如何影响黑人女性的性别观念和性健康，重点关注‘妓女’刻板印象。

faculty.name: Tatum Jolink
faculty.summary: Studies the behavioral and biological mechanisms of close relationships, focusing on positive interactions and the body's role in relationship initiation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究亲密关系中的行为和生物机制，重点关注积极互动以及身体在关系启动中的作用。

faculty.name: Ashley Jordan
faculty.summary: Studies how children form social preferences based on group similarity, using developmental psychology methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童基于群体相似性形成社会偏好的机制，使用发展心理学方法。

faculty.name: Rosa Lafer-Sousa
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain turns sensory data into perception, focusing on color vision in humans and nonhuman primates using psychophysics, brain imaging, and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何将感官数据转化为知觉，重点是人类和非人灵长类动物的颜色视觉，使用心理物理学、脑成像和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Pearl Han Li
faculty.summary: Studies how children balance independent thinking and reliance on others' testimony in developing and updating their beliefs, focusing on moral judgments and social learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童在发展和更新信念时如何平衡独立思考和依赖他人证词，重点关注道德判断和社会学习。

faculty.name: Catherine Marler
faculty.summary: Studies the bi-directional interactions between endocrinology and animal behavior, focusing on California mice and how past winning experience influences future ability to win and androgen receptors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究内分泌学与动物行为之间的双向互动，重点关注加利福尼亚鼠，以及过去获胜经历如何影响未来获胜能力和雄激素受体。

faculty.name: Ali Mohebi
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control processes in rodents using optical and electrophysiological techniques, focusing on neuromodulators like dopamine.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的认知控制过程，使用光学和电生理技术，重点关注多巴胺等神经递质的作用。

faculty.name: Vivian Paulun
faculty.summary: Studies visual intuitive physics, our ability to understand the physics of a scene at a glance, using behavioral experiments, neuroimaging, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉直观物理，即从快速视觉输入中理解场景物理性质的能力，使用行为实验、神经成像和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Seth Pollak
faculty.summary: Studies how early experiences influence children's emotional development and decision-making, using cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期经历如何影响儿童的情绪发展和决策制定，采用认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Carol Ryff
faculty.summary: Studies how various aspects of psychological well-being are influenced by social structural factors and biological processes, linking well-being with health outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理幸福感如何受到社会结构因素和生物学过程的影响，并将幸福感与健康结果联系起来。

faculty.name: Jenny Saffran
faculty.summary: Studies how babies learn language through statistical learning and its relationship to prediction and active sampling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过统计学习来学习语言及其与预测和主动采样的关系。

faculty.name: Kate Walsh
faculty.summary: Studies risk factors for sexual violence and outcomes of victimization, developing prevention and treatment programs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性暴力的风险因素及其后果，开发预防和治疗计划。

faculty.name: Andrew Alexander
faculty.summary: Develops MRI techniques to study brain changes across the lifespan, focusing on infants, adults with Down syndrome, and autism.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发MRI技术研究大脑随生命周期的变化，重点关注婴儿、唐氏综合症成人和自闭症。

faculty.name: Tracy Baker
faculty.summary: Studies the homeostatic regulation of breathing, focusing on mechanisms that prevent central apnea and hypopnea in rats.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究呼吸的稳态调节，特别是防止中枢性呼吸暂停和低通气的机制。

faculty.name: Vaishali Bakshi
faculty.summary: Studies mental illness in rodents, focusing on information-processing abnormalities in schizophrenia and PTSD, using behavioral, neuroendocrine, and molecular methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的精神疾病，重点关注精神分裂症和 PTSD 中的信息处理异常，使用行为学、神经内分泌和分子方法。

faculty.name: Brian A. Baldo
faculty.summary: Studies the neural circuits controlling motivated behavior, particularly feeding, using behavioral, anatomical, and molecular techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究控制动机行为（尤其是进食）的神经回路，使用行为、解剖和分子技术。

faculty.name: Matthew Banks
faculty.summary: Studies how changes in brain activity and connectivity affect consciousness, using behavioral assays and imaging in humans and rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑活动和连接性变化如何影响意识，使用行为测试和成像技术在人类和啮齿动物中进行研究。

faculty.name: Barbara Bendlin
faculty.summary: Studies brain aging and dementia risk factors using neuroimaging and biomarkers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑老化和痴呆风险因素，使用神经影像学和生物标志物。

faculty.name: Craig W. Berridge
faculty.summary: Studies the neural substrates of cognitive enhancement by psychostimulants and the role of CRF neurons in working memory and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知增强的神经机制以及CRF神经元在工作记忆和注意力中的作用。

faculty.name: Tobey Betthauser
faculty.summary: Studies the temporal course of neurodegenerative diseases using longitudinal modeling methods and biomarkers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病的时间进程，使用纵向建模方法和生物标志物。

faculty.name: Rasmus Birn
faculty.summary: Develops new imaging strategies to improve fMRI accuracy and functional connectivity estimates, focusing on resting fMRI fluctuations and brain development.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发新的成像策略以提高功能性磁共振成像的准确性和功能性连接估计，重点关注静息状态fMRI波动和大脑发育。

faculty.name: Melanie Boly
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of consciousness in healthy subjects and neurological patients using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究健康受试者和神经疾病患者意识的神经机制，使用神经影像学技术。

faculty.name: Corinna Burger
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of learning and memory in aging and neurodegenerative disorders using gene therapy and rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病中学习和记忆的分子和细胞机制，使用基因疗法和啮齿动物模型。

faculty.name: Michael Cahill
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and biochemical mechanisms of synaptic plasticity and how genetic and environmental factors impact cognition and behavior in neuropsychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究突触可塑性的分子和生物化学机制以及遗传和环境因素如何影响神经精神疾病中的认知和行为。

faculty.name: Melisa C. Carrasco
faculty.summary: Studies long-term cognitive development of children, focusing on how children's cognitive abilities evolve over time.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童长期认知发展，关注儿童认知能力随时间的变化。

faculty.name: Qiang Chang
faculty.summary: Studies epigenetic regulation of brain functions and brain development, contributing to understanding brain diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑功能和发育的表观遗传调控，以及大脑疾病的机制。

faculty.name: Bradley T. Christian
faculty.summary: Develops and translates novel PET radiotracers to study neurochemical changes in the brain, focusing on neurodevelopment and neurodegeneration.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和转化新型PET示踪剂，研究大脑中的神经化学变化，重点关注神经发育和神经退行性疾病。

faculty.name: Chiara Cirelli
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms and functional consequences of sleep and sleep loss using a variety of methods in animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠和睡眠缺失的机制及其功能后果，使用多种方法在动物模型中进行.

faculty.name: Michelle Ciucci
faculty.summary: Studies the onset and progression of neurodegenerative diseases, particularly Parkinson's, using animal models and human clinical studies to understand communication, swallowing, and cognitive.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，尤其是帕金森病的起始和进展，使用动物模型和临床研究来理解沟通、吞咽和认知功能。

faculty.name: Lindsay Clark
faculty.summary: Improves detection, diagnosis, and treatment of Alzheimer’s disease through remote cognitive assessment and psychosocial outcomes research.
faculty.summary_zh: 改善阿尔茨海默病的检测、诊断和治疗，通过远程认知评估和心理社会结果研究。

faculty.name: LaTasha K. Crawford
faculty.summary: Studies chronic pain mechanisms and peripheral neuropathies using mouse models and veterinary patients, focusing on sensory neurobiology and neuronal circuits.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究慢性疼痛机制和周围神经病变，使用小鼠模型和兽医患者，侧重于感觉神经生物学和神经环路。

faculty.name: Jared Cregg
faculty.summary: Studies brainstem circuits controlling locomotor movement, using advanced techniques to understand motor control and disorders like Parkinson’s disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑干电路控制运动的机制，使用先进技术理解运动控制和帕金森病等运动障碍。

faculty.name: Richard J. Davidson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of emotional reactivity and regulation, impacting vulnerability and resilience, using functional neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪反应和调节的神经基础，影响易感性和韧性，使用功能性神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: David Ehrlich
faculty.summary: Studies interactions between the nervous system and body during movement control, with a focus on development and behavioral state across various species.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经系统与身体在运动控制中的相互作用，特别关注发育和行为状态的影响，涉及多种物种。

faculty.name: Bernadette Gillick
faculty.summary: Studies early brain injury, rehabilitation, and neuroplasticity in children, using neuromodulation techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童早期脑损伤、康复和神经可塑性，使用神经调节技术。

faculty.name: Carey E. Gleason
faculty.summary: Develops and tests Alzheimer’s disease biomarkers in Black and Indigenous populations, focusing on improving timely detection.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和测试阿尔茨海默病生物标志物，重点关注提高黑人和土著人群的早期检测。

faculty.name: Tim Gomez
faculty.summary: Studies intracellular signaling and molecular mechanisms in axon outgrowth and neural circuit formation, linking to cognitive functions like autism and dyslexia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究轴突生长和神经回路形成的细胞内信号传导和分子机制，与认知功能障碍如自闭症和阅读障碍相关。

faculty.name: David Herzfeld
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits for adaptive behavior, using motor control tasks, optogenetics, and machine learning in awake, behaving nonhuman primates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究适应性行为的神经回路，使用运动控制任务、光遗传学和机器学习在清醒行为的非人灵长类动物中进行探究。

faculty.name: Mrinalini Hoon
faculty.summary: Studies the formation, maturation, and function of retinal circuits using transgenic mice, microscopy, and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜电路的形成、成熟和功能，使用转基因小鼠、显微镜和电生理学技术。

faculty.name: Xin Huang
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms underlying visual perception and behavior using electrophysiology, psychophysics, and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和行为的神经机制，使用电生理学、心理物理学和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: Zhen Huang
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of brain development and degeneration, focusing on microglial and neuro-vascular signaling in neurodevelopmental and neurodegenerative diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和退化中的分子和细胞机制，重点关注小胶质细胞和神经血管信号在神经发育障碍和神经退行性疾病中的作用。

faculty.name: Edward Hubbard
faculty.summary: Studies how education and neuroscience intersect, using behavioral and neuroimaging methods with children and adults, especially those with neurodevelopmental abnormalities.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教育与神经科学的交叉领域，使用行为和神经成像方法研究儿童和成人，特别是神经发育异常个体的认知和感觉整合。

faculty.name: Sterling C. Johnson
faculty.summary: Studies brain changes related to Alzheimer's disease, using PET and MRI to identify pre-symptomatic processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与阿尔茨海默病相关的脑部变化，使用PET和MRI识别亚临床过程。

faculty.name: Ned H. Kalin
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological development of anxiety and depression, using translational research methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑和抑郁的神经生物学发展，采用转化研究方法。

faculty.name: Ruth Litovsky
faculty.summary: Studies how the auditory system enables listeners to function in complex environments, using behavioral and neural measures.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉系统如何使听者在复杂环境中正常工作，使用行为和神经测量方法。

faculty.name: Colleen McDowell
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular pathogenesis of glaucoma in the trabecular meshwork, retinal ganglion cells, and optic nerve head to develop disease-modifying therapies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经节细胞、小梁网和视神经头的分子病理机制，以开发治疗青光眼的方法。

faculty.name: Emma Mohr
faculty.summary: Studies the long-term neurodevelopmental outcomes of Zika virus-exposed macaques and the immune responses to congenital Zika virus infection.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究先天性 Zika 病毒感染猕猴的长期神经发育结果及其免疫反应。

faculty.name: Christopher Nicholas
faculty.summary: Studies the clinical efficacy and therapeutic mechanisms of psychedelic compounds like psilocybin and ketamine for addiction, PTSD, and depression, using fMRI as a biomarker.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究致幻化合物（如迷幻蘑菇、 MDMA 和酮胺）在成瘾、PTSD 和抑郁治疗中的临床疗效及其机制，使用功能性磁共振成像 (fMRI) 作为生物标志物。

faculty.name: Caroline Niziolek
faculty.summary: Studies the sensorimotor control of speech, using neuroimaging techniques to understand how feedback from our voices helps us learn and correct speech errors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音产生的传感器运动控制，使用神经影像技术理解反馈如何帮助我们学习和纠正语音错误。

faculty.name: Ozioma Okonkwo
faculty.summary: Studies Alzheimer’s disease risk factors and cognitive resilience, using brain and fluid biomarkers, with a focus on modifiable and non-modifiable factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病的风险因素和认知韧性，使用脑部和体液生物标志物，重点关注可改变和不可改变的因素。

faculty.name: Benjamin Parrell
faculty.summary: Studies the neurobiological and computational bases of speech motor control, using behavioral studies and computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究言语运动控制的神经生物学和计算基础，使用行为研究和计算建模方法。

faculty.name: David T. Plante
faculty.summary: Studies sleep disorders, particularly hypersomnolence, using neurophysiology and high-density EEG.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠障碍，特别是过度嗜睡，使用神经生理学和高密度脑电图方法。

faculty.name: Luis Populin
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of sensorimotor integration, decision-making, and the effects of psychostimulants and vagus nerve stimulation on cognitive function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉运动整合、决策机制以及精神刺激剂和迷走神经刺激对认知功能的影响。

faculty.name: Brad R. Postle
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of human visual cognition, focusing on working memory and attention using fMRI, EEG, and TMS.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类视觉认知的神经基础，重点是工作记忆和注意力，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）、脑电图（EEG）和经颅磁刺激（TMS）。

faculty.name: Vivek Prabhakaran
faculty.summary: Develops multimodal neuroimaging biomarkers for aging and stroke using MRI, fMRI, PET, and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发用于衰老和中风的多模态神经影像学生物标志物，使用MRI、fMRI、PET和机器学习。

faculty.name: Betsy Quinlan
faculty.summary: Studies how synaptic plasticity in the aging mouse visual cortex can be rejuvenated by visual deprivation and light exposure, using psychophysics and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉皮层在老化小鼠中的突触可塑性可以通过视觉剥夺和光照恢复，并使用心理物理学和电生理学方法定义其机制。

faculty.name: Lauren Riters
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of social behavior and vocal communication in songbirds using behavioral and molecular techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸣禽的社会行为和鸣唱交流的神经基础，使用行为和分子技术。

faculty.name: Timothy T. Rogers
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain forms and retrieves concepts, using neural network models and brain imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究概念知识的形成和检索过程，使用神经网络模型和脑成像技术。

faculty.name: Ari Rosenberg
faculty.summary: Studies how hierarchical neural circuits transform sensory signals into precise object representations, using behavioral tasks, neuroimaging, and modeling with human and non-human primates.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究层次神经网络如何将感官信号转化为精确的对象表征，使用行为任务、神经成像和建模方法，涉及人类和非人灵长类动物。

faculty.name: Melissa Rosenkranz
faculty.summary: Studies the bi-directional mind-brain-immune pathways, using neuroimaging to examine the effects of stress and emotion on inflammation and vice versa, with a focus on meditation as a behavioral.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑-免疫-情绪双向路径，使用神经影像学研究压力和情绪对炎症的影响以及反之亦然，并将冥想作为行为干预手段。

faculty.name: Sarah J. Short
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of poverty on brain development and cognitive processes in children using neuroimaging and biomarkers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究贫困对儿童大脑发育和认知过程的影响，使用神经影像学和生物标志物。

faculty.name: André M. M. Sousa
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of human brain development and evolution, and their disruptions in neurodevelopmental disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑发育和进化的分子和细胞机制及其在神经发育障碍中的紊乱。

faculty.name: Pallavi Tiwari
faculty.summary: Develops automated diagnostic tools using radiologic imaging for brain tumor prognosis and treatment evaluation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发基于放射影像的自动化诊断工具，用于脑肿瘤预后和治疗评估。

faculty.name: Giulio Tononi
faculty.summary: Studies the functions and mechanisms of sleep and the neural substrate of consciousness, developing theories like integrated information theory and synaptic homeostasis hypothesis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠的功能和机制以及意识的神经基础，发展了整合信息理论和突触稳态假说等理论。

faculty.name: Brittany Travers
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection between sensorimotor skills and neurobiology in autistic individuals, using MRI and DWI to understand brain contributions to movement and daily living skills.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症谱系障碍个体的运动和感觉运动技能与神经生物学之间的交集，使用MRI和DWI了解大脑对运动和日常生活技能的贡献。

faculty.name: Han Wang
faculty.summary: Studies sleep regulation in C. elegans using genetic tools and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用遗传工具和光遗传学研究秀丽隐杆线虫的睡眠调控机制。

faculty.name: Cody J. Wenthur
faculty.summary: Develops and applies methods to study psychoactive drugs and their effects on learning, memory, and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发和应用方法研究精神活性药物对其学习、记忆和行为的影响。

faculty.name: Cara Westmark
faculty.summary: Studies the effects of amyloid beta on synaptic function in fragile X syndrome and Alzheimer’s disease, using mouse models and therapeutic interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究淀粉样蛋白β对脆性X综合症和阿尔茨海默病突触功能的影响，使用小鼠模型和治疗干预措施。

faculty.name: Jerry Yin
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular bases of memory consolidation in Drosophila, focusing on the role of protein synthesis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇记忆巩固的细胞和分子基础，重点关注蛋白质合成的作用。

faculty.name: JP Yu
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of genes, environment, and gene-environment interactions on brain microstructure in neuropsychiatric illnesses, using MRI and PET.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因、环境及其相互作用对神经精神疾病中脑微结构的影响，使用MRI和PET成像技术。

faculty.name: Xinyu Zhao
faculty.summary: Studies the mechanisms regulating neuronal development and their implications in human intellectual disabilities, including autism, Fragile X syndrome, and Rett Syndrome.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育机制及其在人类智力障碍（包括自闭症、脆性X综合征和雷特综合征）中的作用。

faculty.name: Wang Zheng
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular basis of mechanotransduction in brain development and disorders, focusing on TMEM63 ion channels.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育和疾病中机械整流离子通道的细胞和分子基础。
